name: brainstorming
tagline_zh: 写代码前先别急着动手，让这个技能帮你把需求、设计和隐藏假设一次聊透。它逼你问出那个你总忽略的“为什么”。
tagline_en: Before you code, let this skill dig into intent, requirements, and design—asking the 'why' you'd skip, so you.
desc_en: You MUST use this before any creative work - creating features, building components, adding functionality, or modifying behavior. Explores user intent, requirements and design before implementation.
why_zh: 它不生成代码，而是用苏格拉底式提问逼你澄清需求，比同类工具更早暴露假设漏洞。
why_en: It doesn't write code—it Socratic-questions your intent, exposing assumption gaps earlier than any template-based tool.
